comment: Shared bot-dm envelope fixture. Source: ~/code/paseo-bots/test/fixtures/dm/envelopes.jsonl. Copy kept byte-identical in ~/code/pi-optchat/test/fixtures/dm-envelopes.jsonl. Each case: text (a chat user message), dm (the parsed envelope, or null when the text is not a bot DM), why. Tested by bot-dm/plugin (test/dm-envelopes.test.ts) and pi-optchat (test/dm-envelopes.test.ts).

why: request from FC to a PM; expects a reply
text:
[dm 01M4D2FGN785GQQJA121M20ZAK from the-fat-controller to emmet-brickowski kind=request hop=1 re=- expects-reply]
Please check the DM rollout plan.
Thanks.

why: reply on the same thread, hop 2
text:
[dm 01M4D2GDW8H1EAPE63XGEGXYQ2 from emmet-brickowski to the-fat-controller kind=reply hop=2 re=01M4D2FGN785GQQJA121M20ZAK]
No objection.

why: info between two PMs, no reply wanted
text:
[dm 01M4D3A1B2C3D4E5F6G7H8J9KM from flint to scrat kind=info hop=1 re=-]
FYI: the build is green.

why: info that asks for a reply (--expects-reply)
text:
[dm 01M4D3A1B2C3D4E5F6G7H8J9KN from scrat to flint kind=info hop=3 re=01M4D3A1B2C3D4E5F6G7H8J9KM expects-reply]
Did you see this?

[dm 01M4D3A1B2C3D4E5F6G7H8J9KP from bitzer to the-fat-controller kind=escalate hop=1 re=- expects-reply]
Loop with flint, please decide.

why: herdr worker report; the sender is worker:<name>
text:
[dm 01K6ZQ5V8M0000000000000003 from worker:dm-wp4 to emmet-brickowski kind=report hop=1 re=-]
WP4 done. Report: /tmp/r.md

why: system nudge from the rate-limit watchdog (kind=resume, no reply expected); the second line is added at delivery
text:
[dm 01M4DDD62DPAX2BE3AA35DJ1FH from worker:ratelimit-watchdog to bitzer kind=resume hop=1 re=-]
(System nudge from worker:ratelimit-watchdog, sent automatically: this is not a message from Sam. No reply expected.)
Rate limit reset: resume your task.

why: body starting with a slash command stays after the envelope
text:
[dm 01M4D3A1B2C3D4E5F6G7H8J9KQ from tweety-bird to matilda kind=request hop=1 re=- expects-reply]
/compact
not a command
[dm 01M4D3A1B2C3D4E5F6G7H8J9KR from matilda to tweety-bird kind=info hop=1 re=-]

why: Sam's reply from the DMs tab is his own message
an envelope quoted mid-text is not a DM
text: quoting: [dm 01M4D2FGN785GQQJA121M20ZAK from flint to scrat kind=info hop=1 re=-]

why: a leading space is not an envelope
text:
[dm 01M4D2FGN785GQQJA121M20ZAK from flint to scrat kind=info hop=1 re=-]
hi

[dm 01M4D2FGN785GQQJA121M20ZAK from flint to scrat kind=gossip hop=1 re=-]
hi

text:

hi
